lines:
Done and pushed as 26a9c18 (main -> origin/main).

Delivered: the native textarea resize widget is gone (`resize: none`, no 120px cap). PaneSplitter gained an `orientation="horizontal"` mode — `aria-orientation: horizontal`, row-resize cursor, dragging up grows the value, ArrowUp/ArrowDown adjust and Home/End jump to the bounds — reusing its frame-coalesced preview and commit-on-release behaviour. ChatWorkspaceScreen measures `.chat-main` with a ResizeObserver and renders the separator at the top of `.chat-compose-area`, setting `--aw-composer-height` on it: the panel opens at 200 logical pixels, shrinks no further than 168, and can grow to the Chat column height minus 180 pixels (the timeline always keeps a usable strip). `.composer-shell` became a flex column whose `.composer-input` takes the remaining space, with the attachment strip the first thing to yield; the textarea fills the panel instead of being capped.

Verification: `tsc --noEmit` clean; `pnpm test:chat` 238 passed and `vitest run src/shell src/chat src/app.integration.test.tsx` 246 passed including the new horizontal-splitter test (drag up grows, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End); `pnpm build` ok. The composer height is session state by design (like the pane widths it is not persisted, and the task did not ask for that). `qa/desktop-browser-visual.sh` could not be used as a gate: it is stale relative to this app (it asserts `.evidence-inspector`, an "Add attachment references" label and "Attachments are unsupported in this build", none of which exist in the source), so it fails while interacting with the Chat, unchanged by this work.

Reported: the Chat input panel is small and can only be grown by the tiny native textarea resize widget under the scrollbar (CSS `resize: vertical`, capped at 120px).

Expected: resizing the input panel is a first-class drag on a horizontal separator at the top of the input panel, keyboard accessible, and the panel can grow much larger than 120px while the conversation keeps a usable strip.

Delivered: PaneSplitter gained an `orientation="horizontal"` mode (aria-orientation horizontal, row-resize cursor, drag up grows, ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End). The composer's native textarea resize is removed; `.chat-compose-area` renders the separator above the panel and sets `--aw-composer-height`, the panel opens at 200px and may grow to (chat column height - 180px), and the textarea fills the panel instead of being capped.

Acceptance evidence: tsc clean; `pnpm test:chat` and `vitest run src/shell` green including the new PaneSplitter horizontal test; commit 26a9c18 pushed.

data.title: Resize the Chat input panel with a draggable horizontal separator
